name: Factella – French E-Invoicing for WooCommerce
author: roborock61

sections.description:
From 1 September 2026 every French VAT-registered business must be able to receive electronic invoices, and from 1 September 2027 small and medium businesses must issue B2B invoices electronically and report B2C sales to the tax administration.

Factella prepares small WooCommerce shops for that mandate.

  • Adds optional SIRET and VAT number fields at checkout (block and classic checkout).
  • Validates SIREN, SIRET and French VAT numbers.
  • Numbers invoices and credit notes in one gap-free chronological sequence (PPF-compatible, max 20 characters).
  • Creates an invoice when an order is paid or completed, and a credit note for every refund.
  • Generates a Factur-X file for each invoice and credit note: a PDF/A-3 with embedded EN 16931 CII XML, including the French mandatory mentions and the 2026 national rules (BR-FR). Validated against the official FNFE-MPE validator.
  • Uses the exact WooCommerce VAT rate per line, and handles standard VAT, mixed rates, reduced rates, shipping and fees.
  • Covers the French exemption cases: franchise en base (VATEX-FR-FRANCHISE), intra-EU reverse charge (category K / VATEX-EU-IC) and export outside the EU (category G / VATEX-EU-G).
  • Branded, French, human-readable PDF with your logo and accent colour.
  • Attaches the PDF to the customer’s order emails and offers a download from the customer account.
  • Bulk generation and ZIP export for past orders, plus a wp factella generate WP-CLI command.
  • Exposes the invoice data (read-only) on the WooCommerce orders REST API.
  • Readiness check and a period report (B2B, B2C by VAT rate, refunds) with CSV export.
  • Optional transmission of B2B / B2BInt invoices and credit notes to the SUPER PDP platform with your own SUPER PDP account (manual button or automatic, with status tracking). B2C sales are never transmitted — they belong to e-reporting.
  • Looks up the company name from a SIRET at checkout against the French public business register.

Factella is an independent project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by WooCommerce, Automattic or the French tax administration (DGFiP).

External services

These connections are optional. No data is transmitted until you enter your own credentials and either click a send button or enable automatic sending.

SUPER PDP (approved e-invoicing platform). When you connect your own SUPER PDP account and send an invoice (manually or automatically), Factella authenticates with SUPER PDP using OAuth2 (client_credentials) and transmits the document.
* Data transmitted: your SUPER PDP client ID and client secret (for authentication), and, for each sent document, the Factur-X PDF and its invoice data (seller and buyer legal name, address, SIREN/SIRET, VAT number, line items and amounts), the invoice number (as the external reference), and status/payment events.
* When: only when you click “Test connection”, “Send to SUPER PDP”, or have enabled automatic sending; and periodically to read back the lifecycle status of documents already sent.
* Endpoints: https://api.superpdp.tech/oauth2/token and https://api.superpdp.tech/v1.beta/
* Terms of use: https://www.superpdp.tech/ — Documentation: https://www.superpdp.tech/documentation

Annuaire des Entreprises (recherche-entreprises.api.gouv.fr). At checkout, when a SIRET is entered, Factella asks this free public French government service for the matching company’s legal name to help fill the company field.
* Data transmitted: the SIREN (the first 9 digits of the SIRET). No customer personal data is sent.
* When: only while a SIRET is being entered on the checkout; results are cached for one day and the request is rate-limited.
* Endpoint: https://recherche-entreprises.api.gouv.fr/search
* Terms: https://api.gouv.fr/les-api/api-recherche-entreprises — the data is the open public business register (data.gouv.fr).

Privacy

Factella does not send any data to its developer or to any Factella-operated server. Invoice transmission goes from your site directly to your own SUPER PDP account; the buyer’s invoice data (name, address, SIREN, amounts) is shared only with SUPER PDP, under your account and your agreement with them. The company-name lookup sends only a SIREN (public identifier) to a French government open-data service. All platform credentials are stored encrypted in your own database.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/ and activate it.
  2. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Factella and fill in your legal name, SIREN, VAT number, VAT regime and bank details.
  3. Place a test order and set it to the configured status; the invoice and its Factur-X PDF are created automatically.
sections.faq:
Does this send my invoices to the tax platform?

No. Factella generates compliant Factur-X files and lets you download and email them. Transmission to an approved platform is not included.

Which invoice format is produced?

Factur-X (EN 16931 / “EN16931 Comfort” profile): a PDF/A-3 with the structured CII XML embedded, which is the format required by the French reform.
sections.changelog:
0.3.0

  • New: transmit B2B / B2BInt invoices and credit notes to the SUPER PDP platform with your own account (OAuth2 client_credentials). Manual “Send” button and opt-in automatic sending, queued with Action Scheduler and retried with backoff on transient failures.
  • New: transmission status on the order screen and list (sent / accepted / rejected), polled periodically; clear French error messages (invalid credentials, company not verified, invalid invoice, rate limit, platform unavailable).
  • New: SUPER PDP connection settings (sandbox / production, encrypted secret, “Test connection”), plus connection/verification/sandbox lines in the readiness check.
  • New: company-name auto-fill from a SIRET at checkout via the French public business register (cached, rate-limited, non-blocking).
  • B2C sales are never transmitted (they belong to e-reporting) and are shown as such on the order.

0.2.0

  • Correctness: per-line VAT rate read from WooCommerce (not derived); fees added as invoice/credit-note lines; total reconciled to the order total via the rounding amount (BT-114); unit price with 4 decimals.
  • VAT categories: intra-EU reverse charge (K / VATEX-EU-IC) and export outside the EU (G / VATEX-EU-G), in addition to standard, zero and franchise en base.
  • Pre-generation EN 16931 validation blocks an inconsistent invoice.
  • New: readiness check on the settings tab, and a period report (B2B / B2C by VAT rate / refunds) with CSV export.
  • Logo can be picked from the media library; WP-CLI command renamed to wp factella generate.

0.1.0

  • Business identifiers at checkout, gap-free numbering, invoice and credit note records.
  • Factur-X (PDF/A-3 + EN 16931 CII) generation, validated against the FNFE-MPE validator.
  • Branded French PDF, email attachment, customer download, bulk generation, ZIP export and REST API field.
